text:
Predicates:
LoanedOutTo(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
Footballer(x) ::: x is a football player.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
Nautico(y) ::: y is a football club Nautico.
Braga(y) ::: y is a football club Braga.
Fluminense(y) ::: y is a football club Fluminense.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in y.
Brazilian(x) ::: x is Brazilian.
Name(x, y) ::: x is commonly known as y.
Premises:
Ailton(Silva) ∧ BornIn(Silva, 1995) ∧ Name(Silva, Ailton) ::: Ailton Silva was born in 1995 and is known as Ailton.
Footballer(Silva) ::: Ailton Silva is a football player.
LoanedOutTo(Silva, Braga) ::: Ailton Silva was loaned out to Braga.
PlaysFor(Silva, Nautico) ::: Ailton Silva plays for Nautico.
Brazilian(Silva) ::: Ailton Silva is Brazilian.
Nautico(Nautico) ::: Nautico is a football club.
Braga(Braga) ::: Braga is a football club.
Fluminense(Fluminense) ::: Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
LoanedOutTo(Silva, y) ::: Ailton Silva was loaned out to a football club y.
